notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Minor Update
notes.content:
**Version 1.0.4 Minor Update**  

1. Removed the ability to save during choice selections and added a save point notification.  
2. Added English language support.  

We appreciate your continued support. Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45314030/d7b54996116c32c92f06ec4d8d19d34f181bfbae.png[/img]

notes.title: Known Bugs in v1.0.3
notes.content:
Known Bugs in v1.0.3:

1. In certain situations, after saving and loading a file, the dates on the calendar may display incorrectly.
2. When saving during the selection of options and then loading the file, text errors may occur.

We will fix these issues as soon as possible. Thank you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45314030/04c363fd7fb0b39d82492f2af7ca1df0bbd954ae.png[/img]
